description: Presentation-only field-content groupings and baseline references. Original source-model identities, assertions and review states are retained. Grouping is not full physical-theory equivalence.

reference_papers.title: General solution to the U(1) anomaly equations
reference_papers.authors: Davi B. Costa, Bogdan A. Dobrescu, Patrick J. Fox
reference_papers.inspectedScope: Bibliographic metadata checked against arXiv. Listed independently of the BSM gauge/matter catalogue.
reference_papers.limitations: Not part of the 50-paper model-extraction corpus; no BSM gauge/matter model is inferred from this general result.
reference_papers.noModelReason: General theory paper. Deliberately has no association with any row in the gauge/matter catalogue.

excluded_models.abelian-stueckelberg-sector: An isolated Abelian mass sector, not a specified extension containing the SM gauge/matter content.
excluded_models.u1-two-singlet-flat-sector: A displayed flat-direction toy sector; no SM-containing completion is specified.
excluded_models.u1-minimal-gauge-messenger-toy: A U(1) messenger toy calculation, not an independently specified SM extension.
excluded_models.general-gauge-mediation: A mediation framework with an unselected hidden spectrum; the MSSM visible baseline is not a new field-content entry.
excluded_models.general-gauge-mediation-higgs-operators: An operator/correlator framework without an instantiated hidden matter inventory.
excluded_models.general-heavy-field-tree-matching: A general matching framework with unselected heavy fields. Concrete source examples are catalogued separately.
excluded_models.hidden-valley-framework: The confining group and matter spectrum are unselected; concrete Hidden Valley constructions are catalogued separately.
excluded_models.large-extra-dimensions-framework: A geometric framework retaining the SM field inventory; no additional gauge/matter assignment is instantiated here. The explicit Pati–Salam construction is separate.
excluded_models.rs-two-brane-warped: A geometric extension with localized SM fields. No distinct BSM gauge/matter inventory is specified in this record.
excluded_models.holographic-boundary-pgb-framework: Abstract G/H boundary framework with unselected groups and matter; no concrete gauge/matter model row.
excluded_models.smeft-d6-b-conserving: SM field content with higher-dimensional operators, not a gauge/matter extension.
excluded_models.smeft-d6-b-violating: SM field content with different operators, not a gauge/matter extension.
excluded_models.silh-hww-operator-sector: A software/operator example with SM field content; not an additional BSM field-content model.

groups.name: Two-Higgs-doublet field content
groups.basis: P03 describes Type-I and Type-II Yukawa choices for the same two scalar doublets and SM fermions; Yukawa choices are outside this catalogue.

groups.name: Minimal triplet left–right field content
groups.basis: P04's parity and charge-conjugation choices retain the same gauge/matter inventory. The accepted source-backed re-extraction completes colour, fermion charges, family counts and scalar reality with explicit inherited-baseline and derivation provenance.

groups.name: NMSSM field content
groups.basis: P05's general and Z3-restricted constructions share MSSM field content plus one singlet chiral superfield; operator restrictions are excluded here.

groups.name: Three-Higgs-doublet scalar sector
groups.basis: P08's D6 and D8 scalar-potential variants have three electroweak scalar doublets; no full SM fermion completion is assumed.

groups.name: MSSM field content
groups.basis: P21/P22 use the same MSSM particle content with different operator/parity restrictions. The MSSM shorthand is a declared reference template; source inspection remains partial.

groups.name: DFSZ scalar and fermion field content
groups.basis: P26's DFSZ-I/II variants retain the common two-doublet plus singlet inventory, with different global-charge/Yukawa choices. The source review is partial.

groups.name: SM field content used in effective descriptions
groups.basis: P48/P49 change operators, not the SM particle inventory. This is an EFT/reference row, not a new BSM matter spectrum.

48.basis: P08 source gauge normalization note explicitly records three Higgs doublets with Y=1/2; this is not a full SM completion.

49.basis: Same P08 scalar-sector assignment; gauge normalization note records Y=1/2.

6.basis: The standard 2HDM Higgs doublets are colour singlets. Explicitly completing the omitted colour slot, not treating every missing representation as a singlet.
6.locator: Section 2, Eq. (2), and Section 5.9 (colour breaking is impossible in the 2HDM)
